headline: JSA advises HDFC Bank on ₹1,940 cr financing to Indus Infra Trust
sum: HDFC Bank sanctioned ₹1,940 cr to Indus Infra Trust - the road InvIT backed by GR Infra - to refinance debt of newly acquired SPVs.
detail: HDFC Bank sanctioned ₹1,940 crore financing availed by Indus Infra Trust, the road InvIT platform backed by GR Infra. JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised HDFC Bank. The finances will be used, inter alia, to refinance existing debt of the new SPVs acquired by the Indus Infra Trust.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
sources.blurb: “HDFC Bank Limited has sanctioned ₹1,940 crore financing availed by Indus Infra Trust, the road InvIT platform backed by GR Infra.” - confirms JSA's role and the Karan Mitroo team.
